Document with only script tags produces empty output (scripts are stripped)

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<html><head><script>alert('xss')</script></head><body><script>document.write('hello')</script></body></html>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
